subject: afl-dy
title: (R)AFL.DY.------IST.S.ALGN.------AF.DY.
description: Triple-crossing diagram closing MP(I)-45 — the section on festival funding and the structural realness of those composers 'who have not behaved' (i.e., who don't function within the composite quilt of western continuance). The prose immediately above identifies the structural target: 'what of those individuals who "have not behaved"? That is, what is the reality of those composers whose activity has somehow not been accepted into the composite reality dynamics of western culture?' The triple-axis diagrams the three-step structural ground of that have-not-been-accepted condition: (R)AFL-DY (the reality of affinity dynamics) crossed with IST-S-ALGN (isolated systematic alignment) crossed with (C)AF-DY (the concept of affinity dynamics — the partner-axis's affinity-working that the receiving culture supplies). AFL-DY sits on the left with the subject-arrow; a straight line runs from it through IST-S-ALGN, which sits on the line at top-center as the bridging middle axis, to (C)AF-DY at upper-right as partner-axis. CUL-TR-S drops from the AFL-DY–IST-S-ALGN stretch, so it reads from IST-S-ALGN, with POL-DY (political dynamics) branching from CUL-TR-S's line and (P)RE-DOC (redocumentation as a point of idea completion) from POL-DY's line. From the IST-S-ALGN–AF-DY stretch, which reads from AF-DY, a *dashed* edge runs down to RT-OP (reality options) at the very bottom, and AFN (affinity negation) drops to the right, with (R)INFO-F (the reality of information focus) branching from AFN's line on the right margin. Structural argument: when affinity-dynamics is crossed with isolated systematic alignment is crossed with the concept of affinity-dynamics, the *full three-axis chain* is what would let a form's affinity-alignment actually reach the partner's affinity-dynamics. The dashed edge AF-DY → RT-OP amplifies some aspect of affinity-dynamics. The CUL-TR-S → POL-DY chain is the bridging-axis downward route. (C)AF-DY → AFN → (R)INFO-F is what the partner-axis produces: affinity-negation and, through it, reality-information-focus.
